data.name: io.github.beepboop2025/palimpsest
data.description: Live censorship, China economic, and tamper-evident AI evaluation tools with bounded analysis.
data.title: Palimpsest — censorship, China economy and model-eval observatory

entries.description: The Palimpsest 1.9.0 release boundary exposes six anonymous, read-only tools. It can discover and retrieve public readings, query the fixed bitemporal China economic observation ledger, inspect evidence-newsroom desks, request the bounded board verdict, and keep network and model-layer censorship distinct.
representativeQueries: What do the latest official CFETS repo and SHIBOR observations show, with release and collection clocks?
Retrieve point-in-time China economic observations without using revisions that were not yet known.
What does Palimpsest currently observe about Stock Connect, and what cannot that channel establish?
Is the China economy evidence broad enough for a composite conclusion, or is the observatory abstaining?
Which Chinese information-control measurements are current, stale or missing?

metadata.deploymentNote: This card describes the exact deployed and independently re-probed MCP 1.9.0 boundary.
metadata.liveVersionAuthority: Initialize the linked MCP remote and compare serverInfo.version before treating a release as deployed.

entries.description: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for static public readings, including the China Observatory index, bitemporal economic-observation manifest and ledger, economic pulse, named-series forecast-status artifact, newsroom evidence and evaluation records.
representativeQueries: Give me a keyless API for current China money-market evidence.
Download aggregate China observations with release and collection timestamps.
Check whether Palimpsest has promoted any China economic forecast target.

metadata.versionAuthority: Read info.version from the linked OpenAPI document; it is independent of the deployed MCP release.

entries.description: Aggregate, append-only China economic observations with distinct economic-period, release and collection clocks, revision fields, source IDs, evidence URLs and exact-byte provenance. Current published coverage is the named CFETS benchmark family; it is not complete China-economy coverage.
representativeQueries: What was the published FDR007 observation as known at a specified time?
Show the difference between a CFETS trading day and when Palimpsest collected the print.
Which China money-market series are actually present in the public ledger?

metadata.rights: Palimpsest software, schemas and original metadata are MIT-licensed; source observations retain publisher rights and attribution requirements.
metadata.coverageBoundary: The published manifest is authoritative. Registered or planned sources are not represented as collected rows.

entries.description: Machine index joining current China evidence, source and release clocks, coverage gates, observed Stock Connect statistics and explicit broad-composite abstention without claiming true GDP, causality or general capital-market coverage.
representativeQueries: Is the current China evidence broad enough to state an economy-wide direction?
What Stock Connect evidence is available and where does its scope end?
Which registered China source families are live, warming up, blocked or only planned?

metadata.freshnessAuthority: Read the current generation and source clocks from the linked China index; this catalog does not freeze them.

entries.displayName: Financial Evidence Agent Skill and Fleet Router
entries.description: Canonical Agent Skill that routes questions across Palimpsest China evidence, Seiche system funding and money/capital transmission, LiquiLens institution risk, and Undertow market-exit liquidity without collapsing their evidence boundaries.
capabilities: select canonical MCP and REST surfaces
representativeQueries: Which product should an agent call for China evidence, system funding, institution risk or exit liquidity?
Route a capital-market question without treating one product as universal coverage.
